q1_issues.issue: The consequent event is keyed only to the tide, `(sk_grow $t)`, although the fill event `$e1` is bound in the premise and scopes over it too; per the Skolem-function rule a dependent existential is a function of every universal scoping over it, so as written two fillings by one spring tide yield a single grow event.

notes: Everything else checks out: indicative conditional as a plain Implication rule, definite plural "the tide-pools" as a group witness shared by both clauses, all three compound genera emitted with their noun modifiers unexposed, Agent on the inanimate transitive subject, Patient on the change-of-state intransitive subject, and Location on the growing event.
